items.title: Ohio State Highway Patrol Flock network subscription approval
items.source_attributed_issuer_statement: Controlling Board request DPS0105268 lists approved waiver of competitive selection with $90,000 for FY2024 and $90,000 for FY2025 for a Flock Group subscription supporting unlimited users.
items.evidence_limitation: Approval does not prove invoices paid, term actually performed, real account enablement or additional camera installation. Original HTML response not retrieved by Katoptron's automated monitor.
items.verification_next_action: Executed vendor contract DPS020262, payment ledger and subsequent renewal decision; compare to request FY and actual delivery.

items.title: Lafayette announces Flock suspension and removal process
items.source_attributed_issuer_statement: City statement says its 2027 budget removed Flock funding, it decided to end use, begin early termination and cover the 30 cameras under its city contract pending removal.
items.evidence_limitation: The announcement does not itself prove vendor-accepted termination, completion of every removal, or the status of non-city cameras. The old original Program webpage is still held.

items.title: Raleigh discloses ALPR monthly audits and 30-day data retention

items.evidence_limitation: City disclosure is not independent proof that every audit occurred or all purge processes operated as described.

items.title: Cleveland ordinance authorizes Flock ALPR license and maintenance contracting
items.source_attributed_issuer_statement: City Council Legistar records emergency Ordinance 683-2026 as passed July 15, 2026, effective August 15, authorizing the public safety director to enter one or more Flock annual license/maintenance contracts. Authorization is not proof of a later signed agreement or specific cameras.

items.title: Saint Paul Council adopts resolution calling to end Flock contracts
items.source_attributed_issuer_statement: Resolution RES 26-1421 was adopted by City Council August 26, asking city administration and Ramsey County partners to end contracts, refrain from expansion and report back. Its official status reads Passed Unsigned by Mayor. Resolution is a call, not proof any contract was terminated or cameras removed.
items.evidence_limitation: Did the city administration terminate any agreements after the resolution? Was the requested 60-day implementation report delivered?
